tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement confuse.toml_source.TomlSource(filename,default=False,base_for_paths=False,optional=False) as a ConfigSource. Read standard TOML including tables, arrays and dates; keep absolute filename and metadata. load() parses fully before replacing the same source dictionary, removes deleted keys, preserves last valid state on parse/read error and raises ConfigReadError. Optional missing files become empty, other failures remain errors. Configuration.reload must reload TOML and existing YAML without replacing source identities or disturbing in-memory sources. Do not alter YAML parsing.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_cf_toml_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-cf-toml-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Implement confuse.literal.Literal(expected,default=REQUIRED) as a real Template. Returned mutable values and defaults must be independent copies, without changing legacy Choice or coercive templates.

Add ConfigView.snapshot(template=REQUIRED,*,redact=False) and confuse.snapshots.snapshot(view,...). Without template resolve nested mappings across sources and list subviews using existing view precedence; explicit templates use view.get(template). Deep-freeze dictionaries as read-only mappings and lists/tuples as tuples, retain standard immutable configuration scalar/date/Decimal/Path values, reject cycles and unsupported mutable objects. Snapshot detaches all future source changes. Redact relative marked paths including list elements and whole views as REDACTED. Do not silently serialize values or alter flatten/get.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_cf_snapshot_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-cf-snapshot-dev.md. Implement confuse.trace.trace_sources(view,*,include_values=False,redact=True) returning immutable SourceTrace records in actual view.resolve order. Records contain filename/default/base_for_paths, kind of resolved value, zero-based priority, is_first and optional value. Missing views produce an empty tuple; first means first resolution, not sole contributor to merged dictionaries. Default mode must not expose values.
